summary_1line: Chyavana forces Indra to accept the Aswins in Soma rites by creating the monstrous Mada, after which the gods seek Brahmanas' aid against the virtuous Kapas.

image_candidates.scene_text: The colossal Asura Mada opens a vast mouth spanning earth to heaven while the terrified gods stand upon his enormous tongue.
Indra charges at the sage Chyavana carrying a mountain and thunderbolt, only to be frozen by the rishi's angry glance and a splash of water.
The messenger Dhanin stands before assembled Brahmanas, pleading that the righteous Kapas—devout and disciplined—should not be attacked.
